props.name: pieces
props.description: The pop-up pieces, drawn in order.

props.name: angle
props.description: Opening angle in degrees, 0 (shut) to 180 (flat). Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: openAngle
props.description: Angle a click or Enter opens to. 90 stands parallel folds straight up.

props.name: openOnView
props.description: Open by itself the first time it scrolls into view.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the card along its fold, px.

props.name: depth
props.description: Depth of each page from the fold, px.

props.name: yaw
props.description: Camera turn in degrees. Drag sideways to look around it.

props.name: cover
props.description: Printed on the outside, seen while the card is shut.

props.name: inside
props.description: Printed on the inside of the back page.

props.name: base
props.description: Printed on the base page, under the pieces.
